Re-checks eligibility and the duplicate rule server-side, resolves the Manager (with fallback approver group) and Finance approvers, then routes to the parallel path for small claims or the sequential path at or above the configured threshold using native Flow Designer approvals. Captures the full audit trail and never auto-approves an unknown outcome.
